dedupe_keys.name: ultrasound scans of wind turbine bearings with white etching crack damage

description: Muskulus, Michael and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The images show subsurface white-etching-crack damage in bearings from five constant-load laboratory tests in summer–autumn 2017. Two bearings run in parallel, and both sides of each bearing are scanned. Tests stop after a vibration threshold is exceeded; the fifth test has an explicitly uncertain interpretation because both bearings appear close to failure. The source provides an attenuation-based damage indicator but does not establish a universal field diagnostic threshold. These observations support bearing-condition and fatigue-damage assessment within the stated laboratory setting. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-nc-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
